summary: The coupled lower bound is complete. The dummy board is independent of the planted column; only its erased zero and one cell can change. The erased-zero identity is separate from the search estimate, and a counterexample shows why uniform marginal selection is insufficient without independence. The capped target simulator has two clocks, receives no target-derived address/transcript, and outputs the proposed cell address before reading its contents. Complete-run nonheaviness only implies a prefix cap; it is never conditioned upon. Fixed-time union and uniform-column averaging yield the cell term without an extra m factor. The discrepancy is bounded by6/100, and integer floors lose only constants. The exponent assembly fixes k after alpha and before size, then gives an additional growing-k schedule using the stronger uniform Forrelation threshold. This schedule balances exponential decoder overhead against m raised to minus1/k, and the final exponent tends to four on unbounded-complexity functions. The first paragraphs of Appendix A, through its initial adversary definitions, have also been seen, but the ledger below ends at the completed main-text argument.
